Awards & Reviews

![Bambu Lab Awards and Recognitions](https://cdn1.bambulab.com/home/award/img6-pc.jpg)

[The Bambu H2D isn’t just a bigger 3D printer — it’s a laser cutter, pen plotter, and
Cricut competitor too

Last May, I told you how 3D printers still aren’t easy enough for the mass market, but
Bambu Lab had built the easiest yet. Now, instead of making it easier, Bambu is building
its biggest and most sophisticated model to date — a Swiss Army knife of 3D printers
that can also cut, draw, and
etch.](https://www.theverge.com/news/634294/bambu-lab-h2d-3d-printer-laser-pen-blade-price-release-date)

[Bambu Lab H2D 3D printer review: Your own personal manufacturing hub

The H2D once again aims to disrupt, combining makers’ favourites – such as a 3D printer,
laser engraver, cutter and plotter – into one, essentially providing you with your own
personal manufacturing
hub.](https://www.independent.co.uk/extras/indybest/gadgets-tech/bambu-lab-h2d-3d-printer-review-b2805304.html)

[Bambu Lab H2S 3D printer review

The H2S takes the scale of single-nozzle 3D printing up a notch, and unlike many other
large-scale 3D printers, it offers a brilliant enclosed environment. This enables you to
print with engineering materials, not just mainstream PLA that can be used with open
frame machines.](https://www.techradar.com/pro/bambu-lab-h2s-3d-printer-review)

[Bambu Lab P2S review: Refreshing a best seller

The P2S is a strong choice for anyone wanting to upgrade their 3D printing experience.
Its simple setup and ease of use make it an excellent first printer for a newbie or the
10th printer for a farm.](https://www.tomshardware.com/3d-printing/bambu-lab-p2s-review)

Local Fleet Control with Bambu Farm Manager

JULY 3, 2025 – Managing multiple 3D printers can get complicated, especially when cloud
platforms, third-party services, or limited software options get in the way. With the
launch of Bambu Farm Manager, Bambu Lab is offering a streamlined, cloud-free tool to
manage large printer fleets directly over a local network.

process. Bank transfers are accepted."},"1":{"ques":"Q2: I applied for a tax-exempt
account. How many days does it take to proceed?","ans":"A: After submitting your
application, we will process your B2B account within 3 business days and send you a
confirmation email once it's completed. We appreciate your patience, and kindly refrain
from submitting duplicate requests."},"2":{"ques":"Q3: I have a tax-exempt account. Why
is it still showing taxes?","ans":"A: To access the business account, please click the
\\u003cb\\u003ebutton\\u003c/b\\u003e in the \\u003cb\\u003eB2B email\\u003c/b\\u003e.
Once logged in, you can find a green B2B symbol in the top right corner of your page. On
the checkout page, the final amount will be displayed as the pre-tax
amount."},"3":{"ques":"Q4: Can I get the tax refund after my order has been
fulfilled?","ans":"A: Please understand that we are
\\u003cb\\u003eunable\\u003c/b\\u003e to refund taxes for previous orders if your
account wasn't tax-exempt, or if you didn't log in with B2B account during the purchase.
We can provide invoices. For a refund, kindly reach out to your local tax
agency."},"4":{"ques":"Q5: I need to download the invoice","ans":"The \\u003cbutton
style=\\"outline: none; border: none; background: #1c7cfa; color: #fff; padding:3px;
border-radius:3px; font-size: 10px;\\"\\u003eDownload Invoice\\u003c/button\\u003e
button will appear in your account after the order is fulfilled. Upon delivery of your
package, we will also send a confirmation email with a download link for the invoice
\\u003cbutton style=\\"outline: none; border: none; background: #00AE42; color: #fff;
padding:3px; border-radius:3px; font-size: 10px;\\"\\u003eDownload My
Invoice\\u003c/button\\u003e. Please note we cannot provide the invoice before
shipment."}}},"1":{"title":"Filament Discount","list":{"0":{"ques":"Q1: Filament
discount for everyone","ans":"A: The filaments discount is now available to all
customers without credit limits. You can enjoy discounted prices even if you want to
purchase more than 8 rolls/month. We've also added a discount option for PETG
Translucent. Please note that there is no discount for single-roll purchases. For more
pricing information, please check \\u003ca
href=\\"https://store.bambulab.com/pages/bambu-filament\\"
target=\\"\_blank\\"\\u003ethis page\\u003c/a\\u003e."},"1":{"ques":"Q2: Trails of new
filament","ans":"A: By subscribing to Bambu Lab's newsletter, you'll have the chance to
participate in trials of new filaments before their official
launch."}}},"2":{"title":"Payment","list":{"0":{"ques":"Q1: Failed Payment","ans":"A:
The following steps may help to resolve the issue:\\u003cbr /\\u003e1. Update your
billing address: Ensure that the billing address you entered during the payment process
matches the address associated with your payment card.\\u003cbr /\\u003e2. Check your
shipping address: Make sure there are no abbreviations or errors in your shipping
address that could cause issues.\\u003cbr /\\u003e3. Try a different payment card: If
you have another payment card available, try using it to see if the payment goes
through.\\u003cbr /\\u003e4. Clear browser cache: Clear your browser cache before
attempting the payment again.\\u003cbr /\\u003eIf you have followed these steps and are
still experiencing payment failure, we recommend contacting your bank for further
assistance."},"1":{"ques":"Q2: What are the available payment options, and is it
possible to pay in installments?","ans":"A: For details on payment options and \\"Buy
now, pay later,\\" please check the \\u003ca
href=\\"https://us.store.bambulab.com/pages/payment-help#Menu-Payment-help\\"
target=\\"\_blank\\"\\u003ePayment Help\\u003c/a\\u003e. We offer various payment
options, including credit card payments for quick and secure transactions, installment
plans for flexible budgeting, and an e-wallet option for easy checkout with a few
taps."},"2":{"ques":"Q3: My card has been charged, but I have not received the order
confirmation email.","ans":"A: You can check the order history and order number within
\\"My account\\". The email may have been filtered to your spam
folder."}}},"3":{"title":"Order Status","list":{"0":{"ques":"Q1: Change/add products to
the original order","ans":"A: Once the order processing has started, we cannot make
changes to the order. However, if it has been less than two hours since you placed the
order, you can cancel it by visiting the \\"My Account\\" section."},"1":{"ques":"Q2:
Change shipping address for order","ans":"A: If it's been less than 2 hours since your
order, we suggest canceling it and placing a new one with the correct details.\\u003cbr
/\\u003eIf it's been over 2 hours, you can contact us to try modifications, but we can't
guarantee success.\\u003cbr /\\u003eOnce processing starts, we can only change the name
or house number, not the street, district, or city."},"2":{"ques":"Q3: Is it possible to
cancel my order","ans":"A: If it has been less then 2 hours since you placed the order,
you can cancel it by going to the \\"My Account\\" section.\\u003cbr /\\u003eIf your
order is not yet confirmed or has not been shipped with an ETD(Estimated Time of
Departure), you can contact customer service to attempt a cancellation.\\u003cbr
/\\u003eOnce an order is confirmed, we cannot make any changes to it. If you still want
to cancel, you have the option to refuse the delivery. Please note that in the case of a
non-defective return, you will be responsible for the round-trip shipping
fees."}}},"4":{"title":"Shipping","list":{"0":{"ques":"Q1: No shipping movement for
days.","ans":"A: You can access the latest tracking information for your order \\u003ca
href=\\"https://support.bambulab.com/en/orderInquiry\\"
target=\\"\_blank\\"\\u003eHERE\\u003c/a\\u003e.\\u003cbr /\\u003eIf your order hasn't
shipped, please check the order confirmation email for the Estimated Date of Departure
(ETD). We schedule shipments based on this date, and orders with printers and

Series","learnMore":"Learn
more"},"KickStarterSection4":{"title":"Acknowledgement","desc1":"We express our thanks
to the 3D printing community. We have learned a lot about 3D printing from YouTube
channels, Reddit discussions, and open source projects. We would like to thank Teaching
Tech; his calibration page inspired us to implement the Lidar to do the all important
calibrations automatically. We would also like to thank MirageC. If it had not been for
his HevORT's stunning performance, we would not have set our target acceleration to 20
m/s^2 two years ago. Finally, we would like to thank the Voron team. We have done many
feasibility analyses and evaluation experiments on a Voron 1.8 during the early days of
this project.","desc2":"Creative Commons licensed models are the cornerstones of desktop
